jules.peopleops: Quick escalation  We got an employee admitted to an in-network IOP (Pineview Behavioral Health) for an intensive outpatient program starting tomorrow but their claim for the intake day (Claim IOP-9001) came back OON. Facility says insurer lookup returned a different billing entity. We have prior auth PA-9000 and an EAP referral code EAP-42. Need 1) a rapid temporary letter the facility will accept at check-in, and 2) exact resubmission wording so Pineview can rebill as in-network. They might cancel sessions if we don't act fast.

sam.benefits: Short answer: we can generate a temp proof-of-coverage and the resubmission script. Important: inpatient/IOP facilities often have separate facility NPI vs rendering clinician NPIs; insurer provider files sometimes map to the facility billing TIN. Pineview needs to resubmit using the contracted facility billing entity and include PA-9000 and EAP-42.

pineview-admin: We bill under Pineview Behavioral Health LLC TIN but sometimes claims are submitted under the attending therapist NPI which insurer maps differently. If you can tell us the exact note to put in the claim remarks and whether to use facility NPI or rendering NPI, we'll resubmit immediately.

rita.hr: Also check EAP handoff  does the EAP authorization (EAP-42) affect coverage or is it only referral? Employee is nervous and we need Pineview to hold slots.

eap-bot: EAP referral EAP-42 indicates a warm handoff and may cover an initial assessment; it does not replace medical benefits. PA-9000 is the medical prior authorization for the IOP plan; include both when contacting provider relations.

sam.benefits: Suggested claim remark for resubmission: "Reprocess claim IOP-9001: Prior Authorization PA-9000 applies; EAP referral EAP-42 noted. Please resubmit with contracted facility billing entity Pineview Behavioral Health LLC (billing TIN: 12-3456789) and facility NPI 1234567890. Denial reason: provider/billing entity mismatch. Attach intake summary and PA documentation. Mark as reprocessing/reconsideration and populate claim remark box with PA-9000."

jules.peopleops: Perfect. Can benefits also produce a one-page temporary proof-of-coverage the facility will accept at intake? It should note it's informational only and include insurer phone/portal.

benefits-bot: Draft temporary proof-of-coverage (informational only): "Redwood Inference  Temporary Proof of Coverage. Member: [NAME]. Member ID: [MASKED_ID]. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Coverage effective: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior Authorization: PA-9000 (IOP mental health program). EAP referral: EAP-42 (initial assessment referral). This document is informational only and does not guarantee payment. For claims inquiries or provider reprocessing, call insurer provider relations 1-800-555-0199 or submit a provider portal case at provider.insurer.example.com. Please confirm billing entity (TIN) and facility NPI match insurer provider file before submission."

pineview-admin: That looks good  please include a one-line scheduler script: "Present PA-9000 and EAP-42 at check-in; billing will confirm facility NPI/TIN for claim submission."

benefits-bot: Scheduler script appended to the PDF: "Please present prior auth PA-9000 and EAP referral EAP-42 at check-in. Billing staff: confirm facility NPI 1234567890 and billing TIN 12-3456789 match insurer provider file prior to final billing."

rita.hr: Great. Jules, can you DM employee the PDF and also ask them to sign any intake forms but note financial responsibility only if they elect to proceed and facility requires it? We should prefer resubmission rather than OOP payment.

jules.peopleops: Will do. Pineview, please resubmit now and DM here when done. Sam, can you open provider relations escalation if they get another denial? Attach PA-9000, EAP-42, intake summary and the EOB.

sam.benefits: Yep. I'll open escalation referencing Claim IOP-9001 and PA-9000 if resubmission fails. If insurer declines, route to provider relations and medical appeals with clinical documentation. Keep itemized invoice and intake note.

jules.peopleops: Quick Q: if Pineview resubmits under the facility NPI but insurer still ties payment to rendering clinician, any tips?

sam.benefits: If that happens, ask Pineview to include both facility NPI and rendering clinician NPI on the claim with the billing TIN for the contracted entity. Also request insurer to crosswalk the remittance to the in-network contract via provider relations. We can escalate with a provider contract reference if needed.

pineview-admin: Resubmitted claim IOP-9001 with facility NPI and billing TIN as requested. DMed intake summary and attachment. Holding slots for now.

jules.peopleops: Thank you. I'll confirm with employee and update thread. Please tag this thread on any insurer responses. :heart:
